blocks.text: The module documentation defines stable ordering, conservative token estimation, tool-output capping, clear-then-summarize compaction, protected conversation regions, remembered per-run decisions, and the thrash stop condition. It also states that content is never logged or retained in per-run memory.
blocks.title: Assembler contract and compaction invariants

blocks.text: Constants define environment settings, water marks, caps, protection limits, summary text, and fixed note codes. Estimator helpers count message, tool-call, tool-schema, and whole-context costs, while truncate_middle preserves the head and tail of oversized tool output.
blocks.title: Budgets and estimates

blocks.text: The item helpers tolerate malformed input and identify protocol-shaped user, assistant, and tool rows. They extract valid calls, detect denials, convert through the default assembler, and create rows whose tool outputs may be capped without changing stored items.
blocks.title: Safe item conversion

blocks.text: _Layout records call/result spans, unresolved calls, recent-round boundaries, and valid cut positions. It excludes denials and unresolved-call results from clearing and prevents summaries from splitting a call from its result.
blocks.title: Protected cuts and eligible outputs

blocks.text: _Aggregate counts messages, calls, results, and denials while collecting the person's messages. render produces a server-authored summary with bounded user text and tool counts; _count_list formats bounded name/count lists.
blocks.title: Deterministic summary content

blocks.text: _RunMemory stores only integers and flags for cleared outputs, summary cut, streak, halted state, and prior length. Run keys prefer a bounded run id and otherwise hash stable state plus the first user message; setting helpers validate water marks, positive integers, and environment windows.
blocks.title: Per-run memory and configuration

blocks.text: The assembler validates configuration, preserves the default system message, re-applies remembered decisions, clears old results, chooses a safe summary cut, and emits fixed compaction notes. It catches unexpected failures, provides guarded fallback context, and maintains bounded LRU memory.
blocks.title: Assembly, compaction, and fallback

gotchas: The estimator is characters divided by four, not a tokenizer
The original conversation is never shortened
Unexpected assembly errors fall back to plain context rather than raising

Converts recognizable conversation items into rows
Protects unresolved calls, denials, call/result pairs, and recent rounds
Clears old outputs before replacing old rounds with deterministic summaries
Tracks compaction state in a bounded LRU map
outputs: AssembledContext with ordered messages, tools, and fixed notes
purpose: BudgetedContextAssembler preserves the default system-message construction while ordering tools, system, summary, and history for prompt-cache stability. It estimates size, clears old tool results, summarizes eligible rounds, protects recent and unresolved work, and remembers compaction decisions without retaining conversation text.
summary: Assembles a stable, token-budgeted agent context with capped tool output and mechanical per-run compaction.
